decisions.reason: A quantified customer saving claim gives early evidence of strong value, and as a modular extension of the core range in a growing firm it is worth keeping as the upside now looks less uncertain and abandonment value is low.

The shredder sits close to the firm’s established machinery base and having its own page suggests a real commercial push, so with uncertainty still not fully resolved and limited option-holding cost the sensible choice is to keep it on the market.

Because this product line is presented as a flagship and fits the firm’s stated strategic direction toward modular cleaner generations, management would be very unlikely to abandon it after only one year while its option value remains high.

The trommel screen appears less strongly validated than A or C, but as a close-to-core machine in an expanding German equipment maker it is still more rational to preserve the option for another year than to drop it prematurely.
